title: Epimedin B exerts an anti-inflammatory effect by regulating the MAPK/NF-kappaB/NOD-like receptor signalling pathways.
authors: Liu, Li; Zhong, Yayun; Zheng, Te; Zhao, Jingcheng; Ding, Shumin; Lv, Jinpeng; Xu, Qian; Zhang, Yun
one_liner_zh: 该文研究中药成分Epimedin B的抗炎作用，涉及MAPK/NF-kappaB信号通路基因表达，但无蛋白质-DNA互作、无结合建模、无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Epimedin B (EB), a predominant compound found in Herba Epimedii, has been shown to be effective in the treatment of osteoporosis and peripheral neuropathy. However, the anti-inflammatory effect of EB has not yet been reported. The anti-inflammatory activity of EB was evaluated in a zebrafish inflammation model induced by copper sulfate (CuSO(4)) and tail cutting. Our findings demonstrated that EB effectively inhibited acute inflammation, mitigated the accumulation of reactive oxygen species (ROS), and ameliorated the neuroinflammation-associated impairment of locomotion in zebrafish. Moreover, EB regulates several genes related to the mitogen-activated protein kinase (MAPK)/nuclear factor-kappaB (NF-kappaB)/Nod-like receptor signalling pathways (mapk8b, src, mmp9, akt1, mapk14a, mapk14b, mapk1, egfra, map3k4, nfkappab2, ikappabalphaa, pycard, nlrp3 and caspase1) and inflammatory cytokine (stat6, arg1, irfa, stat1a, il-1beta, il-4, il-6, il-8, cox-2, ptges, tnf-alpha and tgf-beta). Therefore, our findings indicate that EB could serve as a promising therapeutic candidate for treating inflammation.
abstract_zh: 淫羊藿苷B（Epimedin B, EB）是淫羊藿（Herba Epimedii）中的主要化合物，已被证明对治疗骨质疏松和周围神经病变有效。然而，EB的抗炎作用尚未见报道。本研究在硫酸铜（CuSO(4)）诱导及尾部切割的斑马鱼炎症模型中评估了EB的抗炎活性。我们的研究结果表明，EB有效抑制急性炎症，减轻活性氧（reactive oxygen species, ROS）的积累，并改善斑马鱼中与神经炎症相关的运动障碍。此外，EB调节了与丝裂原活化蛋白激酶（mitogen-activated protein kinase, MAPK）/核因子-κB（nuclear factor-kappaB, NF-kappaB）/Nod样受体信号通路相关的多个基因（mapk8b、src、mmp9、akt1、mapk14a、mapk14b、mapk1、egfra、map3k4、nfkappab2、ikappabalphaa、pycard、nlrp3和caspase1）以及炎症细胞因子（stat6、arg1、irfa、stat1a、il-1beta、il-4、il-6、il-8、cox-2、ptges、tnf-alpha和tgf-beta）。因此，我们的研究结果表明，EB可能成为治疗炎症的有前景的候选药物。
